title: Registered error codes
description: Registered error codes with their default retryable value. The root validates one registration entry. Codes with x-finplan-retryable-fixed must always carry their default. Adding a code is a minor release.

VALIDATION_FAILED.description: Request or document failed schema or semantic validation.

INVALID_IDENTIFIER.description: An identifier has the wrong prefix or format for its field.

NOT_FOUND.description: The referenced record does not exist in this environment.

CONFLICT.description: expected_revision does not match the current revision.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.description: The idempotency key was used with a different request hash.

IMMUTABLE_RECORD.description: The record is immutable; create a child version instead.

PRECONDITION_FAILED.description: A lifecycle precondition is not met (for example publishing an unvalidated version).

UNAUTHORIZED.description: The caller could not be authenticated.

FORBIDDEN.description: The caller is not allowed to perform the operation.

OPERATION_NOT_PERMITTED.description: The operation is not permitted in this phase (for example live execution).

BUDGET_EXCEEDED.description: The cost estimate exceeds the remaining budget allocation, or budget enforcement is active.

RATE_LIMITED.description: A dependency or the producer throttled the request.

DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.description: A required producer release or dependency is absent or unavailable.

UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT_VERSION.description: The declared contract major is not served; details list the served majors.
